title: Section-normalized action-site presentation of condensed inflation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], with its modules and internal $G$-actions [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], and let $G$ be a topological group. Use the small profinite parameter site $B$, its finite-cover topology and group sheaf $K_G$ of [def-sfb-profinite-action-base-coefficients], and the twisted action site and normalized geometric restriction of [lem-sfb-action-topos-geometric-restriction]. Define $R_G$ to be literal precomposition of a commutative ring sheaf $R$ along the projection $C_{K_G}\to B$. An action-site presentation datum for $A,G$ consists of $R$ equal to the original section-ring sheaf transported by $B\to\mathrm{Profinite}$; additive equivalences from original modules to $R$-module sheaves and from original action modules to $R_G$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]; section identifications with the original section modules commuting with all restrictions and morphisms, with twisted restriction given by the original local action, and with scalars identified by the specified section-ring equality; ordinary tensor comparisons identifying every pure tensor with the original internal tensor [def-sfb-condensed-action-tensor]; an isomorphism from trivial inflation to the specified normalized module pullback, equal to the identity on these sections; and an isomorphism from the actual module direct image to the existing invariants functor [def-sfb-condensed-derived-invariants], identifying the actual pullback adjunction Hom transpose with its invariant-inclusion transpose. Define the action-site module category and the pure-tensor generator in the ordinary signed total complex using these existing tensors and the actual summand inclusion [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. A datum imposes these equations and does not assert existence.
